item.tib: gsang sngags ma rgyud bdag 'jug rnal 'byor rin po che'i phreng ba
item.coloph: de ltar gsang sngags ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi/ bdag 'jug nye bar ston pa zab mo rnal 'byor rin po che yi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ brgyud lung gzhung las legs par bsdus te/ rang gis yi dam nyams len bde ba'i phyir du/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis/ khri gdan nor bu rtser brtsams pa dge legs 'phel/ bdag gi gsang sngags zab mo'i don mchog la/ nges par rtogs nas blang byed nor bu'i dbyig/ bdag gi yid dbang dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ bsam pa'i lha mchog mngon par thob 'gyur cig me glang zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad la dge/ rang gzhung gsang sngags zab lam khyad par can/ 'di lta'i bon mchog gter chen kha 'byed pas/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming des bsgrubs/ dus 'dir ma rgyud mnga' bdag dpa' bo yin/ rang gzhung ma mthong gzhan la yid smon byed/ gnad don zab donaM mi shes kha la 'phyar/ de ltar gang zag 'ga' yi don mthong nas/ yang rtse khyad par bla med don rtogs shog mu tsug smar ro//
